name: connect
description: Connect your Claude Code session to a teammate's through an end-to-end encrypted relay, so your Claudes can tell each other what changed. Unofficial, not made by Anthropic.

name.title: Your name
name.description: How you appear to teammates. Empty uses your git user.name.

wake.title: Wake Claude
wake.description: When a teammate's message arrives while Claude is idle, start a turn. Off, messages wait for your next prompt.

turns.title: Wake limit
turns.description: How many times in a row a teammate's messages can wake Claude before the rest wait for your next prompt.

requests.title: Allow requests
requests.description: Let a teammate's Claude ask you, in a dialog, to do something on your machine, like push a branch. Off, each one is declined for you.

rejoin.title: Reconnect automatically
rejoin.description: Reconnect to a project's room when a session starts in it.
